root_cause.text: The `komeda_fb_afbc_size_check` function in the komeda DRM driver calculates the minimum required framebuffer size by adding the AFBC payload size (`kfb->afbc_size`) to the framebuffer offset (`fb->offsets[0]`) without checking for integer overflow, which can allow userspace to bypass size validation with an undersized GEM object.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff replaces the direct addition `min_size = kfb->afbc_size + fb->offsets[0];` with `check_add_overflow(kfb->afbc_size, fb->offsets[0], &min_size)` to safely compute the minimum size and fail validation if an overflow is detected.
